Indian Rupee Declines Against US Dollar Amid Global Factors

The Indian rupee fell by 21 paise to 94.97 against the US dollar in early trade. Forex traders attributed the decline to a strong US dollar, although a positive domestic market and softening crude oil prices provided some support. Reports of diplomatic efforts between the U.S. and Iran contributed to a fall in oil prices.
